description: Read-only. A webhook's delivery history, newest first (kept 30 days): each event sent, its status (pending = waiting for a retry, delivered, failed = gave up after 6 attempts), attempts, last HTTP status or error and the next retry time. A permanent error (e.g. unsafe_target) fails at once. Payloads are never returned. Without webhookId it lists the workspace's webhooks (id, receiver site, events, active) so you can pick one. Use it when a webhook seems to have stopped.

webhookId.description: The webhook id; omit to list the webhooks first

name: list_webhook_deliveries
title: List webhook deliveries
